row.evidence: JumpCloud documents a SCIM 2.0 server (https://api.jumpcloud.com/scim/v2) that any HRIS or directory with a SCIM client can use to create, update and suspend JumpCloud users, and its self-serve SSO package ($11/user/mo billed annually) includes Cloud Directory and User Lifecycle Management.
row.notes: Status stays free, but the plan changed: the June 'Free (up to 10 users)' plan is gone, and the pricing page now offers only a 30-day free trial. Self-serve per-user packages: Device Management $9, SSO $11 and Device Identity Management $13 per user/mo billed annually; Platform Essentials (max 300 users), Platform and Platform Prime are Contact Sales. Recorded as inbound SCIM (provisioning users into JumpCloud). The SCIM server docs name no plan gate; their prerequisites are a JumpCloud organization and an admin API key that does not expire. The pricing table shows Cloud Directory and User Lifecycle Management (outbound SCIM to apps) with checkmarks on the SSO package and above, but not on Device Management, which is the device-only (MDM) product. So SSO, the cheapest identity package, is taken as both team and SCIM plan. The checkmarks are images and the package mapping comes from the page HTML, so confidence is medium. The SCIM server takes users only, not groups, and Okta deactivate or delete suspends the user. Entra uses a non-gallery app with a feature-flag tenant URL. Okta has an OIN SCIM app. Google Workspace and M365 users are pulled in by JumpCloud's own directory import. Full REST user API (v1 systemusers, v2 user groups) and the Directory Insights audit API are documented; their plan gates are not.

plans.name: Device Management
plans.notes: Device-only (MDM) package; the pricing table shows no checkmark for Cloud Directory or User Lifecycle Management on this package (checkmarks are images).

plans.name: SSO
plans.notes: Includes Cloud Directory, SSO to apps, User Lifecycle Management and Directory Insights per the pricing table (image checkmarks).

auth.token_source: Admin portal > your initials > My API Key / API Settings (admin API key, used as the IdP's Secret Token)
auth.notes: Docs describe the admin API key as used in the custom x-api-key header and entered as the IdP's 'API Key/Secret Token'.

deprovision.data_retained: User is kept in JumpCloud in a suspended state.

attributes.notes: From the generic SCIM server attribute table. userName is required, may not be an email and allows no special characters. 'company' maps to organization and 'location' to locale. Entra does not support the manager attribute.

limitations.text: Real-time group import is not supported; groups must be toggled off in the IdP.
Entra needs the ?aadOptscim062020 feature flag on the tenant URL for updates and deprovisioning; without it only new users are created.
Users inactive in the source are not created in JumpCloud; imported users start password-pending (generic, Entra) or Staged (Okta) and get no activation email.
userName may not be an email; Okta maps the email prefix and Entra maps mailNickname.

auth.notes: The API key is tied to the administrator and grants that admin's full console access; no scopes.

endpoints.purpose: Manage the members of a user group (v2)

audit_log_api.notes: Directory Insights API (POST /events, /events/count, /events/distinct, /events/interval; GET /reports). The pricing table checkmarks show Directory Insights on the SSO package and above.

okta.notes: OIN 'JumpCloud' app is tagged OIDC and SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate and Sync Password. The OIN also lists 'JumpCloud SWA' and 'JumpCloud Provisioning Connector by Aquera' (third party).

entra.notes: JumpCloud says it is not in the Entra gallery; provisioning uses a non-gallery app with Automatic provisioning to the SCIM server.

google.notes: JumpCloud's Google Workspace integration imports users (manual or hourly automatic import); it is run by JumpCloud, not a Google Marketplace SCIM app.

jumpcloud.notes: Not applicable: JumpCloud is the vendor.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace and M365/Entra directory import, HRIS connectors (e.g. BambooHR), Okta real-time user and password import

open_questions: Which packages may use the inbound SCIM server and the REST/Directory Insights APIs; the docs give no plan gate and the pricing table's package checkmarks are images.

Which package includes External Identity Federation (sign-in to JumpCloud with the customer's own IdP), needed for sso_plan; the checkmark images suggest Device Management, Device Identity Management and Platform tiers, but not the SSO package.
Whether a SCIM DELETE removes the user or only suspends it (Okta delete maps to suspend; Entra offers a Delete target action).
SCIM filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented.
